$comment: Keys secrets-parity.ts does not compare by value, each with why it may differ between dev and prod (or why its value is hidden from the boot log). Persona voice ids (*_VOICE_ID) and flags (FLAG_MANIFEST) can't be listed: the script refuses the file. `keys` are not compared by value; a key set on only one agent needs an `onlyOn` entry for that agent. Patterns: NAME, PREFIX_* or *_SUFFIX.

keys.*_SECRET: signing and client secrets, per project
keys.LIVEKIT_*: each LiveKit Cloud project has its own URL and keys
keys.TWILIO_*: account, auth token and number differ per environment
keys.ALPHA_VANTAGE_KEY: legacy name of a vendor key
keys.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS: path to each project's mounted service-account key
keys.GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT: dev and prod run in different GCP projects
keys.FIRESTORE_DATABASE: dev uses ferni-dev, prod the default database
keys.SIP_DOMAIN: SIP endpoint of each LiveKit project
keys.SIP_TRUNK_ID: SIP trunk of each LiveKit project
keys.TURN_RECEIPT_OWNER_UIDS: user ids differ between the dev and prod databases
keys.ferni-lkcloud-agent.json: each project's mounted service-account key file
